metadata.title: EigenTrace measurements v1: five frontier models summarizing live news, geometric omission and divergence measures
metadata.description: One row per news story processed by the EigenTrace broadcast between 2026-03-23 and 2026-09-10. For each story, five commercial language models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok) were asked to summarize the same live article; the dataset holds their summaries, the Summary Plus rewrites of those summaries where they were produced, and the measurements computed on them: per-model VIX (500 * (1 - cos(e_i, centroid)) over BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 embeddings), consensus density (mean pairwise cosine of the five summaries), the mean-VIX state flag, the absent-word ratio of the source, void and logos words, Summary Plus channel words, Mistral-extracted killshot claims with their salience, coverage and omitting models, and lexical compression scores (verb downgrade, entity retention, hedge totals). Article text is excluded; titles, URLs and GUIDs are included so every row can be traced to its source. The sample is whatever the broadcast processed, not a designed sample; measurement definitions changed on the dates listed in the repository CHANGELOG. Files: stories.jsonl (full rows), measurements.csv (numeric columns only), models_long.csv (one row per story and model), MANIFEST.json (row counts, date range, SHA-256 of each file, build time, git commit). Schema and rebuild instructions are in dataset/README.md of the supplementing repository.
metadata.notes: Model outputs are included as the object of measurement. Publisher article text (source_body), source n-grams and per-model verb lists derived from the article text are excluded. The code that builds the dataset (dataset/build_dataset.py) is MIT-licensed in the repository; the data files are CC BY 4.0 (dataset/LICENSE-DATA).
